name: device_cleanup
description: Clean up device storage, memory, and cache safely. All operations are real-time and do not require network access. Supports dry-run mode to preview cleanup before execution.

operation.description: One of: scan_storage | clean_cache | clean_temp | clean_memory | system_info. Defaults to scan_storage.

target.description: Target to clean: 'temp', 'cache', 'all', or a specific path.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually perform destructive cleanup. Defaults to false (dry run).

dry_run.description: If true, only scan and report without deleting anything. Defaults to true.

author: Stella
